defmodule UploadConsumer do
  @moduledoc """
  GenServer-based message queue consumer that processes
  user-uploaded archive files from a RabbitMQ queue.
  """
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_archive_size 50 * 1024 * 1024  # 50MB compressed limit
  @max_entry_count 1000
  @extraction_timeout 30_000
  @max_single_file 100 * 1024 * 1024  # 100MB per file

  defstruct [:channel, :queue, :storage_path]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    storage_path = Keyword.get(opts, :storage_path, "/tmp/uploads")
    File.mkdir_p!(storage_path)
    state = %__MODULE__{storage_path: storage_path}
    schedule_poll()
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:poll_queue, state) do
    case fetch_next_message(state) do
      {:ok, message} ->
        process_upload(message, state)
      :empty ->
        :ok
    end
    schedule_poll()
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp schedule_poll do
    Process.send_after(self(), :poll_queue, 1_000)
  end

  defp fetch_next_message(_state) do
    # Simulated queue fetch - in production this reads from AMQP
    :empty
  end

  @doc """
  Main processing pipeline for uploaded archives.
  Validates size, extracts safely, and stores results.
  """
  def process_upload(%{payload: archive_bytes, metadata: meta}, state) do
    upload_id = meta[:upload_id] || generate_id()
    Logger.info("Processing upload #{upload_id}")

    with :ok <- validate_compressed_size(archive_bytes),
         {:ok, entries} <- safe_list_entries(archive_bytes),
         :ok <- validate_entry_count(entries),
         :ok <- validate_total_uncompressed(entries),
         {:ok, dest} <- extract_archive(archive_bytes, entries, upload_id, state) do
      Logger.info("Successfully processed upload #{upload_id} to #{dest}")
      {:ok, dest}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warn("Rejected upload #{upload_id}: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp validate_compressed_size(archive_bytes) do
    if byte_size(archive_bytes) <= @max_archive_size do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :compressed_too_large}
    end
  end

  defp safe_list_entries(archive_bytes) do
    case :zip.list_dir({:binary, archive_bytes}) do
      {:ok, [_comment | entries]} -> {:ok, entries}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, {:invalid_archive, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp validate_entry_count(entries) do
    if length(entries) <= @max_entry_count do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :too_many_entries}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Validates total uncompressed size by summing declared sizes
  from the zip central directory headers.
  """
  defp validate_total_uncompressed(entries) do
    total = compute_declared_size(entries)
    max_uncompressed = @max_archive_size * 10  # 500MB max uncompressed

    if total <= max_uncompressed do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :uncompressed_too_large}
    end
  end

  # Computes total declared uncompressed size from zip headers.
  # Note: uses the `uncomp_size` field from :zip_file records.
  defp compute_declared_size(entries) do
    Enum.reduce(entries, 0, fn entry, acc ->
      case entry do
        {:zip_file, _name, info, _comment, _offset, _comp_size} ->
          # info is a :file_info record; extract size field
          declared = extract_file_size(info)
          acc + declared
        _ ->
          acc
      end
    end)
  end

  # Extracts size from :file_info record tuple
  # :file_info record: {:file_info, size, type, access, atime, mtime, ctime, mode, ...}
  defp extract_file_size(info) when is_tuple(info) do
    # The size field is at position 1 in the :file_info record
    elem(info, 1)
  end
  defp extract_file_size(_), do: 0

  defp extract_archive(archive_bytes, entries, upload_id, state) do
    dest_dir = Path.join(state.storage_path, upload_id)
    File.mkdir_p!(dest_dir)

    task = Task.async(fn ->
      do_streaming_extract(archive_bytes, entries, dest_dir)
    end)

    case Task.yield(task, @extraction_timeout) || Task.shutdown(task) do
      {:ok, result} -> result
      nil ->
        File.rm_rf!(dest_dir)
        {:error, :extraction_timeout}
    end
  end

  # Streaming extraction that processes entries one at a time with
  # actual size verification post-extraction
  defp do_streaming_extract(archive_bytes, entries, dest_dir) do
    file_names = Enum.map(entries, fn
      {:zip_file, name, _info, _comment, _offset, _comp_size} ->
        sanitize_path(name)
      _ -> nil
    end) |> Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)

    max_total = @max_archive_size * 10

    result = Enum.reduce_while(file_names, {:ok, 0}, fn name, {:ok, running_total} ->
      charlist_name = String.to_charlist(name)
      case :zip.extract({:binary, archive_bytes}, [{:cwd, String.to_charlist(dest_dir)}, {:file_list, [charlist_name]}]) do
        {:ok, _files} ->
          extracted_path = Path.join(dest_dir, name)
          # Defense-in-depth: verify the resolved extracted path stays
          # within dest_dir before trusting/measuring it.
          if path_within?(dest_dir, extracted_path) do
            case File.stat(extracted_path) do
              {:ok, %File.Stat{size: actual_size}} when actual_size <= @max_single_file ->
                new_total = running_total + actual_size
                if new_total <= max_total do
                  {:cont, {:ok, new_total}}
                else
                  File.rm_rf!(dest_dir)
                  {:halt, {:error, :actual_uncompressed_too_large}}
                end
              {:ok, %File.Stat{size: _}} ->
                File.rm_rf!(dest_dir)
                {:halt, {:error, :single_file_too_large}}
              {:error, _} ->
                {:cont, {:ok, running_total}}
            end
          else
            File.rm_rf!(dest_dir)
            {:halt, {:error, :path_traversal_detected}}
          end
        {:error, reason} ->
          {:halt, {:error, {:extraction_failed, reason}}}
      end
    end)

    case result do
      {:ok, _total} -> {:ok, dest_dir}
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

  # Ensures target resolves to a location inside base_dir (prevents CWE-22).
  defp path_within?(base_dir, target) do
    base = Path.expand(base_dir)
    resolved = Path.expand(target)
    resolved == base or String.starts_with?(resolved, base <> "/")
  end

  defp sanitize_path(name) when is_list(name) do
    sanitize_path(List.to_string(name))
  end
  defp sanitize_path(name) when is_binary(name) do
    # Reject absolute paths and any traversal components rather than
    # relying on naive substring stripping (which is bypassable, e.g.
    # "....//" -> "../"). Rebuild the path from safe components only.
    name
    |> String.split(~r{[/\\]+})
    |> Enum.reject(fn part -> part in ["", ".", ".."] end)
    |> Enum.join("/")
  end

  defp generate_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.hex_encode32(case: :lower) |> binary_part(0, 16)
  end
end
